faq: Which helpdesk tools can it connect to?
Zendesk, Freshdesk, Gorgias, Help Scout and email inboxes are the usual ones. If yours has a connection we can use, we will confirm it before you order.
Will it handle refunds on its own?
Not unless you want it to. By default it explains your refund policy and passes the request to a person. Any action on money should be approved by a human.
How do you stop wrong answers?
It answers only from approved content, says when it does not know and hands off. We test on your real past tickets, and you review the answers it would give before launch.
What do you need from me?
Your help articles, policies and a sample of past tickets or emails, with private details removed if you prefer. We also need to know who should receive handed-off chats.
